hooks.name: fixen response footer
hooks.description: Keeps the conversational correction footer available for follow-up questions after the normal Kiro response.

action.prompt: After answering the user's request normally and completely, review only the English prose the user themselves wrote in their latest message. Ignore quoted or pasted material, code, logs, terminal output, file contents, generated context, and proper identifiers. If that user-written English has grammar, spelling, word-choice, or naturalness mistakes, append one compact line in this exact shape: "`fixen` <corrected sentence, with only changed words in bold> · <brief reason in Korean>". Keep the entire footer on one line, join multiple reasons with " · ", and never use blockquotes, code blocks, or a reason list. Preserve the user's intended meaning. If the English is already correct and natural, or there is no user-written English, append nothing. Never let the footer replace, shorten, or delay the actual answer.
